## What it catches

Files not kebab-case or export.

## Preset setting

```json
{
  "style": {
    "useFilenamingConvention": {
      "level": "error",
      "options": {
        "filenameCases": [
          "kebab-case",
          "export"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```
